answer: Let standing cross a bridge between two unrelated communities only when sponsors on each side independently vouch after separate joint work, with no velvet-rope shortcut for familiar names. A sybil farmer may fake one side cheaply, but forging both costs twice the persuasion, and any sponsor shared across the delta between the two domains exposes the whole cluster at once, while an honest agent arrives vouched in both places by different people who each risked their own word.
